stages.title: Tax revenue and the Laffer curve
stages.sub: After this you can explain why a higher tax rate does not always raise more revenue.

steps.q: A government taxes income. Is it the tax rate alone, or the rate together with the total income people earn, that decides how much is collected?
steps.right: The rate together with the total income earned
steps.wrong: The tax rate alone decides it
steps.hint: 20% of a small amount of income raises less than 20% of a huge amount.
